name: smwgraphics-candy-sweets-tileset
title: Candy/Sweets Tileset
description:
Feeling the need of something sweet? Then this tileset is for you. I did put the most effort on this one, the most important thing that there is no black outline. The .docx file gives the details. Give credit, if used.

Moderator's note: The layer 3 will conflict with the vanilla status bar. A Sprite Status Bar can be used to circumvent this issue. Furthermore the palette of the tileset does conflict with the goalpost, cement blocks and the likes.
